name: skaldir-market-research-dataset
disclaimer: Static curated RESEARCH reference data compiled for the Skaldir docker-tool-dashboard feature. No live prices, NO TRADES, no market actions. Fields describe published research facts and qualitative bands as of the as_of date only.

AMD.research_note_brief: Designs CPUs and GPUs; sells into the datacenter and client markets
AMD.research_note_full: Designs CPUs (Zen family) and datacenter GPUs; revenue is concentrated in server accelerators and client computing; competitive pressure comes from the incumbent CPU vendor and the dominant AI accelerator vendor; cyclic demand is the standing sector risk
AMD.analysts_view: Datacenter share gains are the thesis; valuation is sensitive to AI-cycle sentiment

NVDA.research_note_brief: Designs AI accelerators and networking for datacenters
NVDA.research_note_full: Dominant supplier of AI training and inference accelerators; datacenter revenue is highly concentrated among a few cloud buyers; export controls on the China market are a structural policy risk; gaming and professional graphics are secondary
NVDA.analysts_view: Ecosystem lock via CUDA is the moat; the debate is how long the datacenter buildout sustains

INTC.research_note_brief: Integrated device maker pivoting into a contract foundry
INTC.research_note_full: Designs and manufactures x86 CPUs and is rebuilding its process lead through the IDM 2.0 foundry transition; execution risk in process nodes and capital intensity dominate the research debate; AI PC demand is a secondary driver
INTC.analysts_view: The foundry pivot is binary: either process execution recovers or cash burn continues

TSM.research_note_full: The world-lead contract manufacturer for advanced logic; geopolitical exposure of Taiwan is the standing tail risk; advanced packaging capacity is the newest bottleneck; customer concentration among AI accelerator buyers is rising
TSM.analysts_view: Structural beneficiary of every AI accelerator, independent of whose chip wins

MU.research_note_brief: Memory maker exposed to DRAM and NAND pricing cycles
MU.research_note_full: Pure-play memory; earnings swing with DRAM and NAND spot pricing; high-bandwidth memory for AI accelerators is the premium segment; oversupply phases historically compress margins to near breakeven
MU.analysts_view: Cycle timing plus HBM share decide the thesis, not unit growth
